import urllib.request, json
queries=['repo:mruby/mruby dispatch_linked PEEK_S','repo:mruby/mruby "PEEK_S(s->iseq+pos0)"','repo:mruby/mruby "dispatch_linked" "codegen.c"']
for q in queries:
 url='https://api.github.com/search/issues?q='+urllib.parse.quote(q)
 print('URL',url)
 try:
  req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'openhands'})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20) as r:
   data=json.load(r)
   print(data.get('total_count'))
   for it in data.get('items',[])[:5]: print(it['html_url'],it['title'])
 except Exception as e: print('ERR',repr(e))
